name: Stock ticker
description: Up to five shares, indices, currencies or cryptocurrencies with their change today, from EODHD with your own API key (Euronext, US and most other exchanges).

settings.label: EODHD API key
settings.help: From your account at eodhd.com (a free account works). Used only for your own frame.

settings.label: Symbols
settings.help: Up to five, separated by commas, as EODHD writes them: CODE.EXCHANGE. Add =Name to choose the name shown, e.g. GSPC.INDX=S&P 500.

settings.label: API calls per day
settings.help: Your EODHD plan's daily limit: 20 on the free plan. Every symbol costs one call per refresh; the refreshes are spread between 9:00 and 22:00.
